name: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends
source:
Flirt with Spanish folklore creatures, save (or doom) humanity, and, if you earn their trust, unlock their true monstrous form

Meet five romanceable myths, each with their own drama, secrets, and a tendency to snack on humans from time to time. Your choices decide whether you end up in love, betrayed, or just… obliterated.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654990/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与西班牙民间传说中的生物调情，拯救（或毁灭）人类，如果你赢得了他们的信任，就可以解锁他们真正的怪物形态

认识五个浪漫的神话，每个神话都有自己的戏剧、秘密，以及时不时地吃人类零食的倾向。你的选择决定了你最终会陷入爱情、被背叛还是……被抹杀。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654990/]Steam[/url]]
